FAQ

Questions? Answered.

Still have a question?

Our specialists reply fast on WhatsApp, 7 days a week.

WhatsApp us Call us
Which areas in Qatar do you cover?

We install across Doha, Lusail, The Pearl, West Bay, Al Rayyan, Al Gharrafa, Al Kheesa, Al Wakra and surrounding areas — on-site at your home, office or parking spot.

How does pricing work?

Affordable, flat-rate pricing with no hidden fees. Send us photos or sizes on WhatsApp and we’ll reply with a free estimate.

How much heat and UV does window film block?

Our films block 99% of UV rays, and premium automotive films reject up to 60% of solar heat. Exact performance depends on the film you choose.

What’s the difference between nano ceramic and regular tint?

Regular dyed tint mainly darkens glass. Nano ceramic films use ceramic particles to reject infrared heat without heavy darkening, don’t interfere with phone or GPS signals, and won’t fade or turn purple.

Do you accept cashless payment?

Yes — secure, seamless cashless payments with flexible options for every service.

How quickly can you book me in?

Booking takes less than 60 seconds on WhatsApp, and we work 7 days a week from 8 AM to 6 PM.
